name: Peel
subtitle: Review Instagram relationships on your device.
description: The official Peel Altsource for compatible sideloading tools. Peel is a free, open-source iPhone and iPad app for reviewing imported Instagram follower relationships.

apps.name: Peel
apps.subtitle: Your Instagram review space.
apps.localizedDescription:
Compare followers and following from an Instagram export, review mutual and non-mutual connections, and keep review progress on your device.

Peel supports search, sorting, exclusions, JSON backups and private profile-photo caching. Demo Mode includes a bundled sample archive with fictional relationships.

Follow and unfollow decisions are performed manually on Instagram. Peel does not automate account actions. Instagram browsing and uncached profile photos require internet access.

versions.localizedDescription: Improved exclusions, account-row alignment, profile-photo recovery and private caching. Added Reset Data controls, native login confirmations, the About version display, startup release notifications and a manual Check for Updates option. Sample archive import now appears on Review in Demo Mode.
